Retail trade sales (Preliminary), June 2026

Retail trade sales increased by 1,6% year-on-year in June 2026. The largest positive annual growth rates were recorded for general dealers (4,1%).

In May 2026, retail trade sales decreased by 0,4% year-on-year in May 2026 (revised).

Seasonally adjusted retail trade sales increased by 0,3% month-on-month in June 2026.
